integrity: Proof is self-contained and checker is exact symbolic/rational; no independent mathematical audit or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Only classical constant-step BDF2 fractional convolution weights with 0<alpha<1 are classified; not start-up corrections, other BDF orders, or whole-scheme maximum principles. Relevant numerical sign observations were present in 2023 and are credited; an equivalent specialist coefficient proof might exist. Finite tests support but do not substitute for the analytic induction.
title: An all-index sign and tail-monotonicity theorem for fractional BDF2 convolution weights
